S.FORM: tee=ku pu-a-iisua sua iiku ia, muʔu.
S.PHON: teeku puaiisua sua iiku ia muʔu
S.FORM: teeku puaiisua sua iiku ia, mu'u.
S.PHON: teeku puaiisua sua iiku ia muʔu
S.TRANSL: I am Mu'u, who will talk.
(I will talk about) the mountain I used to visit when I was still a small child.
I would not tell lies in the past.
It would be bad for me to tell lies.
The elders all knew it
I used to set up traps.

S.FORM: ma-naasə=ku cani vuan ia, ma-naasə=ku um-ala vavulu, maanə u-rucin si sua iiku ia, kaʔan=ku pu-a-rəsəvə.
S.PHON: manaasəku ʦani vuan ia manaasəku umaɾa vavuɾu maanə urutʂin ʂi sua iiku ia kaʔanku puarəsəvə
S.FORM: manaaseku cani vuan ia, manaaseku umara vavuru, maane urucin si sua iiku ia, ka'anku puareseve.
S.PHON: manaaseku ʦani vuan ia manaaseku uma[r|ɾ]a vavu[r|ɾ]u maane u[r|ɾ]utʂin ʂi sua iiku ia kaʔanku pua[r|ɾ]eseve
S.TRANSL: It is true that I caught 12 wild pigs in a month because I don't tell any lies.

S.FORM: pu-a-rəsəvə=kia ia, aaka taavalaʔə kaa-vaŋvaŋ ma-maaraŋ
S.PHON: puarəsəvəkia ia aaka taavaɾaʔə kaavaŋvaŋ mamaaraŋ
S.FORM: puaresevekia ia, aaka taavara'e kaavangvang mamaarang
S.PHON: pua[r|ɾ]esevekia ia aaka taava[r|ɾ]aʔe kaavaŋvaŋ mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: It would be bad should I tell a lie, all elders would know it.

S.FORM: miana ia, canaa=maku sipaar-a. ni-a-rupaca=maku vavulu, pausua-ʔuma.
S.PHON: miana ia ʦanaamaku ʂipaara niarupaʦamaku vavuɾu pausuaʔuma
S.FORM: miana ia, canaamaku sipaara. niarupacamaku vavuru, pausua'uma.
S.PHON: miana ia ʦanaamaku ʂipaa[r|ɾ]a nia[r|ɾ]upaʦamaku vavu[r|ɾ]u pausuaʔuma
S.TRANSL: In the past, I had fields on the other side of the river, and I used wild pigs (I hunted) to reward those who help with farming.

S.FORM: mia-isua ia, pausua-ʔuma=ku ia, paira cuma ʔuna i-vatu ʔikua.
S.PHON: miaisua ia pausuaʔumaku ia paira ʦuma ʔuna ivatu ʔikua
S.FORM: miaisua ia, pausua'umaku ia, paira cuma 'una ivatu 'ikua.
S.PHON: miaisua ia pausuaʔumaku ia pai[r|ɾ]a ʦuma ʔuna ivatu ʔikua
S.TRANSL: At that time, whenever I rewarded the field workers, my father always came to me (to help).
He would always (help) with cooking.
He would cook meat.

S.FORM: ni-pu-ʔucip-an=ci ia, su-avu-avuŋ=cu caau sua ni-putu-kia-kiau.
S.PHON: nipuʔutʂipantʂi ia suavuavuŋʦu ʦaau sua niputukiakiau
S.FORM: nipu'ucipanci ia, suavuavungcu caau sua niputukiakiau.
S.PHON: nipuʔutʂipantʂi ia suavuavuŋʦu ʦaau sua niputukiakiau
S.TRANSL: Having cooked (the meat), (we) would share it with the workers.
This is what the Kanakanavu term pausuaʔuma refers to.
Having eaten meat, we would drink wine.
Since then, the elders would start chatting.

S.FORM: paaraʔəna=ci ma-maaraŋ ia, ʔakia kari-in cucuma-ini.
S.PHON: paaraʔənatʂi mamaaraŋ ia ʔakia kariin ʦuʦumaini
paa[r|ɾ]aʔenatʂi mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ ia ʔakia ka[r|ɾ]iin ʦuʦumaini
S.TRANSL: The elders wouldn't say anything else.
They would only talk about mountains and wild animals.

S.FORM: iimu ma-maaraŋ miana ia, paaraʔəna=ci ia, apanaapa=ku mu-kusa ʔinia t<un>mana kaari ma-maaraŋ.
S.PHON: iimu mamaaraŋ miana ia paaraʔənatʂi ia apanaapaku mukusa ʔinia tunmana kaari mamaaraŋ
S.FORM: iimu mamaarang miana ia, paara'enaci ia, apanaapaku mukusa 'inia t<un>mana kaari mamaarang.
S.PHON: iimu mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana ia paa[r|ɾ]aʔenatʂi ia apanaapaku mukusa ʔinia tunmana kaa[r|ɾ]i mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ
S.TRANSL: So in the past, when the elders were chatting, I would sometimes go there and listen to what they were saying.

S.FORM: iimuu=ku m-ala-taavalaʔə=ku si t<in>mana=cu=ku kaari ma-maaraŋ miana.
S.PHON: iimuuku maɾataavaɾaʔəku ʂi tinmanaʦuku kaari mamaaraŋ miana
S.FORM: iimuuku marataavara'eku si t<in>manacuku kaari mamaarang miana.
S.PHON: iimuuku ma[r|ɾ]ataava[r|ɾ]aʔeku ʂi tinmanaʦuku kaa[r|ɾ]i mamaa[r|ɾ]aŋ miana
S.TRANSL: How I know something is because I heard the elders talking in the past.

S.FORM: cəpəŋ=aku taka-cii-cini ia, mata-lava maamia naisi sua taavalaʔ-an=aku.
S.PHON: ʦəpəŋaku takatʂiitʂini ia mataɾava maamia naiʂi sua taavaɾaʔanaku
S.FORM: cepengaku takaciicini ia, matarava maamia naisi sua taavara'anaku.
S.PHON: ʦepeŋaku takatʂiitʂini ia mata[r|ɾ]ava maamia naiʂi sua taava[r|ɾ]aʔanaku
S.TRANSL: This is my own thought and this is all that I know.
Thank you, stay healthy my professor!
